## You Are All Sherlock Holmes Now
<br>
based on what I am going to **read**, and what you already got from **my accent**, guess <u>where I am from</u><br>
when you make a guess, you can ask me to re-read a sentence if you need<br>
please only focus on the **sound**<br><br>
.pull-left[
<br><br>
<img src="../pic/0902/holmes1.png" width="49%">
<img src="../pic/0902/holmes2.png" width="49%">

]

.pull-right[
<i>
<span style="color:blue">Good morning, everyone. My name is Merlin, and I’m delighted to welcome you to our course. </span><br>
<span style="color:#cc0033">In this class we shall explore how language works, from the smallest sounds to the most fascinating structures.</span><br>
<span style="color:green">You may notice that I pronounce certain words rather differently from what you usually hear.</span><br>
<span style="color:purple">For instance, I say bath with a long vowel, not short, and schedule with a ‘sh’ sound rather than a ‘sk’.
</span><br>
<span style="color:brown">You’ll also hear me articulate the ‘r’ at the ends of words far less.</span>
</i>
]
<br><br>

--
<div style="text-align:center">
You are able to mimic an accent if you know the <b><span style="color:#cc0033">phonology</span></b>, which is the pattern of sounds<br>
sometimes, <b><span style="color:#cc0033">social factors</span></b> also matter, sadly, we will not cover it in this class
</div>

## **Now Its Your Turn**
<br>
1. talk to your neighbours and form a group naturally <br><br>
2. write your **First Name**.**Last Name** (**Preferred Name**) and (**Preferred Pronouns**) on the name tag <br><br>
3. one by one, introduce yourself to the group, tell others: <br><br>
  - your name and your preferred name
  - your major<br><br>
4. when introducing, write down the way you pronounce your name though **it might be spelt in another way** <br><br>
5. **one representative** from each group write down name pronunciation of everyone in the group on the board<br><br><br><br>

**NOTE**: BE **CREATIVE**!
